messages:
maria: Quick postmortem follow-up from this morning's authz spike. TL;DR: token validation race produced stale cached claims for ~3m, and our audit shipper dropped a small window. I want to capture owners + a short remediation handshake so this doesn't recur.
aj: Thanks — can you paste the minimal repro and the suggested quick fixes?
maria: repro is in the incident doc: https://internal.redwood.com/ops/incident/2280013371 — minimal steps: deploy order was service-B -> service-A; service-A relied on cached claims and didn't revalidate on 401. Fix options: 1) aggressively invalidate cache on role-change events, 2) optimistic revalidate on 401, 3) increase audit shipper retries.
devon: I can own the cache invalidation work (small PR). Target: rollback-safe change, feature-flagged. ETA EOD Fri.
aj: I'll own the optimistic revalidation on 401 path and add an integration test. ETA Tue next week.
ops-sre: I'll investigate why the audit shipper dropped events — looks like transient backpressure (kafka spikes). Putting in a mitigation to buffer locally + retry. ETA tomorrow morning.
maria: Great. Let's capture action items in one place so oncall doesn't get pinged repeatedly. Proposed short checklist: 
- [ ] DEVON: PR for cache invalidation + feature flag (link: will post PR)
- [ ] AJ: revalidate-on-401 integration test + flag toggle
- [ ] OPS-SRE: audit-shipper retry buffer, monitor alert threshold
- [ ] MARIA: update runbook to include 'force token refresh' step and add an example curl command for local repro

maria: Example curl for repro (use a token that will be rolled):
`curl -i -H \"Authorization: Bearer $STALE_TOKEN\" https://api.redwood.com/v1/resource`
If 401 then service should hit /v1/validate and refresh cache, not crash.
aj: I'll add the integration test that simulates token swap and ensures a 401 triggers revalidation. Will link PR when ready.
devon: PR opened: https://git.redwood.com/redwood/runtime/pulls/1428 - includes feature flag `auth.cache_invalidation_v2`. Requesting review from @aj and @ops-sre.
ops-sre: I added a temporary alert on audit-shipper consumer lag: alerts at 5m lag -> slack #eng-oncall + pager. Will roll back to previous consumer config if we see >2 incidents in 24h.
security-bot: Created ticket SEC-2985: "stale-token-cache + audit gap" and linked to SRV-4313. Add watchers: maria, aj, devon, ops-sre.
maria: Scheduling a 15m handoff tomorrow 09:30 PST to go over rollout plan and rollback criteria. Please bring the PR links and test logs.
aj: I'll bring the test run and trace spans that show validation flow.
devon: I'll bring the rollout plan and the feature flag kill-switch script.
ops-sre: I'll provide audit-shipper metrics and mitigation steps.
maria: Ok — final note: let's treat this as a 1-week remediation sprint with daily 10m standups until all items are closed. If any owner needs more time, flag it in the ticket. :thumbsup:
aj: ack
devon: ack
ops-sre: ack
security-bot: SEC-2985 status updated: in_progress.
